intro.title: NovaBizGuard: Commercial & Industrial Machine Protection System
intro.description: NovaBizGuard is a modular Machine Protection System (MPS) designed for commercial and industrial customers. NovaBizGuard helps cut demand charges, reduce diesel generator (DG) dependency, lower electricity bills by up to 50%, stabilize power supply, and unlock reliable EV charging and solar + MPS solutions across factories, buildings, and microgrids.
